result.instructions: Tools for Cloudways, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our servers are stopped right now?"; "Show the traffic top URLs for our main WordPress site over the last day."; "Clear the cache of the shop application on server 12345.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cloudways data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cloudways_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cloudways_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cloudways_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cloudways_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cloudways_list_servers
tools.title: List servers
tools.description: List the Flexible servers on the account with status, provider, region and app count. Good first call to find a server_id. Cloudways API: GET /servers.

provider.description: Filter by cloud provider code (for example do, vultr, linode, amazon, gce).

status.description: Filter by server status: 1 = running, 0 = stopped.

tools.name: cloudways_get_server
tools.title: Get server
tools.description: Get the details of one Flexible server: label, cloud, region, instance type, IP and status. Cloudways API: GET /servers/{serverId}.

server_id.description: Numeric id of the server (from cloudways_list_servers).

tools.name: cloudways_get_server_settings
tools.title: Get server settings
tools.description: Get the PHP and server settings of a server (memory_limit, upload_size, execution_limit, timezone) and its installed package versions. Cloudways API: GET /server/manage/settings.

server_id.description: Numeric id of the server (from cloudways_list_servers).

tools.name: cloudways_get_server_usage
tools.title: Get server usage
tools.description: Get bandwidth usage (type bw) for a server, or disk size per application (type db). Cloudways API: GET /server/monitor/summary.

server_id.description: Numeric id of the server (from cloudways_list_servers).

type.description: "bw" for server bandwidth usage, "db" for disk size per application.

tools.name: cloudways_get_operation
tools.title: Get operation status
tools.description: Check a background operation (for example a server restart or a backup) by its operation_id. Returns whether it is still running, completed or failed. Cloudways API: GET /operation/{id}.

operation_id.description: The operation_id returned by a write tool.

tools.name: cloudways_list_regions
tools.title: List regions
tools.description: List the cloud regions available for each provider (for new servers). Cloudways API: GET /regions.

tools.name: cloudways_list_server_sizes
tools.title: List server sizes
tools.description: List the server sizes (instance types) available for each cloud provider. Cloudways API: GET /server_sizes.

tools.name: cloudways_list_apps
tools.title: List applications
tools.description: List the Flexible applications on the account (WordPress, Laravel, Magento and others), with their server and state. Use the app_id with the other app tools. Cloudways API: GET /apps/flexible.

app_type.description: Filter by application type, for example wordpress or laravel.

tools.name: cloudways_get_app
tools.title: Get application
tools.description: Get the details of one Flexible application: label, domain, server, app type and version. Cloudways API: GET /app/{appId}.

app_id.description: Numeric id of the application (from cloudways_list_apps).

tools.name: cloudways_list_app_types
tools.title: List application types
tools.description: List the application types and their available versions (use these when choosing an app for a new server). Cloudways API: GET /apps.

tools.name: cloudways_get_app_traffic
tools.title: Get application traffic
tools.description: Get traffic analytics for an application over a period: top IPs, bots, URLs or status codes. Cloudways API: GET /app/analytics/traffic.

server_id.description: Numeric id of the server (from cloudways_list_servers).

app_id.description: Numeric id of the application (from cloudways_list_apps).

tools.name: cloudways_get_app_logs
tools.title: Get application logs
tools.description: Get recent access or error log lines of an application. Pick the log type and the source tab. Cloudways API: GET /app/logs/{type}.

type.description: access = request logs, error = error logs.

server_id.description: Numeric id of the server (from cloudways_list_servers).

app_id.description: Numeric id of the application (from cloudways_list_apps).

resource.description: Log source tab, as shown in the Cloudways UI (for example backend or static for access logs).

tools.name: cloudways_get_app_cron_jobs
tools.title: Get application cron jobs
tools.description: List the cron jobs of an application on a server. Cloudways API: GET /app/manage/cronList.

server_id.description: Numeric id of the server (from cloudways_list_servers).

app_id.description: Numeric id of the application (from cloudways_list_apps).

tools.name: cloudways_get_app_vulnerabilities
tools.title: Get application vulnerabilities
tools.description: List the known vulnerabilities found for an application (from the Cloudways security scan). Cloudways API: GET /app/vulnerabilities/{app_id}.

server_id.description: Numeric id of the server (from cloudways_list_servers).

app_id.description: Numeric id of the application (from cloudways_list_apps).

tools.name: cloudways_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects that group servers and applications on the account. Cloudways API: GET /project.

tools.name: cloudways_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the team members that have access to the account. Cloudways API: GET /member.

tools.name: cloudways_list_alerts
tools.title: List CloudwaysBot alerts
tools.description: List the server and application alerts raised by CloudwaysBot, newest first. Cloudways API: GET /alerts/.

tools.name: cloudways_get_billing_summary
tools.title: Get billing summary
tools.description: Get the billing summary of the account: current month charges and the estimated amount due. Cloudways API: GET /account/billing/summary.

tools.name: cloudways_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of the account, newest first. Cloudways API: GET /account/invoices.

tools.name: cloudways_restart_server
tools.title: Restart server
tools.description: Restart a server. Every app on it goes offline for a short time. Returns an operation_id to poll with cloudways_get_operation. Cloudways API: POST /server/restart.

server_id.description: Numeric id of the server (from cloudways_list_servers).

tools.name: cloudways_clear_app_cache
tools.title: Clear application cache
tools.description: Clear all cache of an application (page cache and object cache). Safe to repeat. Cloudways API: POST /app/cache/purge.

server_id.description: Numeric id of the server (from cloudways_list_servers).

app_id.description: Numeric id of the application (from cloudways_list_apps).

tools.name: cloudways_update_server_label
tools.title: Rename server
tools.description: Change the label (display name) of a server. Safe to repeat with the same label. Cloudways API: PUT /server/{serverId}.

server_id.description: Numeric id of the server (from cloudways_list_servers).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Cloudways
prompts.description: What you can do with Cloudways here, with example requests to try.
